description: This Java source file 'MainActivity.java' defines the main activity of an Android application in the package 'com.example.android.advancedimmersivemode'. It initializes the user interface with a fragment and manages a logging overlay, providing menu options to toggle the log view. The file extends a custom base activity and interacts with various components including fragments, menus, and logging utilities.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling UI setup, menu options, and logging initialization for the application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI, sets content view, and adds the fragment if activity is created for the first time.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, toggling visibility and label of log display options.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, particularly toggling the log overlay visibility.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with custom log nodes and prepares on-screen log display.
